subject: GEOMETRY
pageTitle: SOHCAHTOA: Sine, Cosine and Tangent Explained
description: Remember sine, cosine and tangent with SOHCAHTOA, choose the right ratio, and solve for a side and an angle in two worked examples.
caption: SOHCAHTOA in 7 swipes: which ratio to use, how to label the sides, and two worked examples. Save this for your next geometry quiz. Free Geometry study guide at precisstudy.com/geometry (no sign-up).

slides.title: SOH-CAH-TOA
slides.note: Label the sides from the angle you are using.

slides.title: PICK THE RIGHT RATIO
slides.note: Two sides in the problem decide the ratio.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Find x. The angle is 30°, the hypotenuse is 10, and x is opposite the angle.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Find θ. The opposite side is 3 and the adjacent side is 4.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Tangent uses the two legs: opposite over adjacent.
Opposite and adjacent swap when you switch to the other angle.
Set your calculator to degrees, not radians.
